plan: Drive: from District of Vanderhoof, about 99 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.46505, -123.32742, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 110 m N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2018 cutblock (310 m E) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-11, Region 7A. Season: mule deer bucks Oct 1 to Oct 31 and more rows (synopsis page 57, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
